original_intent: Make recurring Buildkite pipelines green for standard PRs, release PRs, pushes, and merges to master; document each failure in one GitHub Issue and publish the fix PR.
derived_intent: Resolve the smallest proven adapter/configuration incompatibilities first, change workflows only when necessary, preserve security gates, verify locally and in GitHub, and publish one issue plus one PR.
next_transitions: Run local proof gates, publish issue, push PR, inspect Buildkite rerun
active_boundaries: Repository workflow and GitHub repository configuration only; no unrelated product changes.
repo_scope: Decapod repository CI, release, docs, environment, and Buildkite adapter compatibility surfaces.
declared_commands: gh pr checks 1334/1335 and historical PR checks
evidence: GitHub Actions passed on PR 1335 while Buildkite build 39 failed only on adapter-sensitive jobs; recurring summaries identify path filters, environment metadata, and checkout token incompatibilities.
shortcut_risk_signals: Do not treat GitHub Actions success as sufficient; wait for Buildkite checks on the published PR.
unresolved_assumptions: The Buildkite adapter is external and its job logs are not available through the repository; exact post-push check results are the final proof.
